purpose: Synthetic-at-rest, nominal-physics stationary hold diagnostic; not trajectory or policy acceptance
reference_attribution: Copyright2026 Wuji Technology Co., Ltd.; see docs/sim2real/third-party/wuji/

conditions.control: Constant nominal position-servo targets; fixed wrist equality

limitations: No approach from a canonical reset, trajectory replay, retiming, delay or randomization.
Static hold failure does not prove a moving reference phase is infeasible.
Summed normal contact forces do not establish force closure.
A stationary hold is not rotation success or deployment acceptance.
artifact_kind: Summary with all 32 paired initial states, endpoints and peak statistics

replication.note: Same frozen reference and script; nonlinear contact dynamics need not be bit-identical across platforms.
